memo.memo_markdown:
# Next-quarter product effort: billing and premium entitlement

Prioritize billing/support, focusing discovery and product work on the premium restrictions represented in BIL-99. It is the #1 baseline issue, with complaint count 6 [C1], mean severity 3.000000 [C2], and priority score 18 [C3]. The area totals are 6 complaints, severity sum 18, mean severity 3.000000, and 1 cancellation-intent record.

## Why
BIL-99 ranks first in the saved issue ranking. It is a catch-all, but its definition specifically includes controls limited to premium; evidence reviews describe restrictions on song choice, queueing, and listening to specific parts of songs (608ce9f2-5238-44ae-b034-1d47654c8d63; 63cbb139-212c-486a-a98f-5e55bd7a0a29). This makes entitlement friction a concrete area to investigate. The #1 rank is the baseline comparison; BIL-99 ties USB-99 on priority score [C4].

## Alternatives considered
Usability has area totals of 7 complaints, severity sum 18, mean severity 2.571429, and 1 cancellation-intent record. Its ranked USB-99 issue has priority score 18 [C4], but is a broad catch-all. Playback has 5 complaints, severity sum 13, mean severity 2.600000, and 1 cancellation-intent record; PLB-99 has priority score 11 [C5], below BIL-99. Other has 5 complaints, severity sum 11, mean severity 2.200000, and no cancellation-intent records; OTH-99 has priority score 11 [C6] but names no specific feature. These are lower-priority alternatives for a focused feature effort, not evidence that their problems are unimportant.

## Evidence
The billing reviews describe basic features becoming premium-only (d99c7236-c788-411f-9b98-648be3278983; 7833aee5-f57c-465a-9fac-66952efb9dca). One reviewer says they feel like uninstalling (608ce9f2-5238-44ae-b034-1d47654c8d63); this is expressed intent, not observed churn.

## Limitations
These are saved aggregates of 40 in-scope, self-selected reviews dated 2022-06-26 to 2023-11-10, not a representative user sample. Cancellation language is intent, not observed churn or causal evidence. Catch-alls may combine distinct issues: BIL-99 includes premium controls, while OTH-99 is nonspecific. Facts report no quarantined or pending-unclassified records, but issue-level catch-alls remain. The available issue categories limit what can be inferred.

ranked_issues.name: Other billing complaints
ranked_issues.definition: billing complaints that fit none of the specific billing issues (Price, charges, subscriptions, refunds, paywalls, premium entitlement; controls explicitly limited to premium (e.g. 'can't pick songs without premium', 'only 6 skips') go here.)

ranked_issues.name: Other usability complaints
ranked_issues.definition: usability complaints that fit none of the specific usability issues (Navigation, controls, layout, UI changes, queue/playlist management, ad interruptions (e.g. 'new home screen is confusing', 'too many ads between songs').)

ranked_issues.name: General dissatisfaction (no specific feature)
ranked_issues.definition: Complaints that name no specific product problem, e.g. 'worst app', insults or vague anger

ranked_issues.name: Other playback complaints
ranked_issues.definition: playback complaints that fit none of the specific playback issues (Playback failure, crashes, freezing, lag, songs stopping or skipping by themselves, connection failures, audio quality, battery/data/storage use.)

ranked_issues.name: Other catalog complaints
ranked_issues.definition: catalog complaints that fit none of the specific catalog issues (Missing songs or artists, removed content, search and discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability, podcasts content.)

ranked_issues.name: Other access complaints
ranked_issues.definition: access complaints that fit none of the specific access issues (Login, signup, password or account access problems (e.g. 'can't log in', 'account hacked', 'logged out every day').)

ranked_issues.name: Other downloads complaints
ranked_issues.definition: downloads complaints that fit none of the specific downloads issues (Downloading songs, saved music, offline listening, downloads disappearing.)

inputs.ranking_rule: priority_score = complaint_count x mean_severity = severity_sum; ties by issue_id
